rules_p1_body: A Hanafuda deck contains 48 cards divided into 12 monthly suits of 4 cards each. Cards belong to 4 categories: Lights (20 pts), Ribbons (5 pts), Animals (5 pts), and Plain Chaff (1 pt).
rules_p2_body: Match cards from your hand with table cards of the same month. Forming Yaku (Lights, Ribbons, Animals, Plain) earns points. Calling Koi-Koi continues the round for more points, but if your opponent forms a Yaku first, they win the round.
rules_p3_body: Players must reach 3 points before calling Go or Stop. Key Yaku include 5 Birds (Godori), Ribbons, and Junk cards. Winning with 3+ Go, Gwang-bak (Light Penalty), or Pi-bak (Junk Penalty) doubles total round scores.
rules_p4_body: A standard match lasts 12 rounds (Jan to Dec). The player with the highest total score after 12 rounds wins the match. In Bet Mode, double up your winnings by guessing if the next card is Big or Small.
